title: A new part starts in Uncategorized and a category change reprices it
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, on matrix A.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one range from $0.00 and Default on Markup % 50, pricing category A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Start a new inventory part from Parts › Inventory.
  2. Type 10 in the part's cost.
  3. Pick category A as the part's category.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The new part's category reads Uncategorized.

Step 2:

  • The cost reads $10.00.

Step 3:

  • The category reads category A.
  • The sell price becomes $15.00, from matrix A ($10.00 × 1.50 = $15.00).
